step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identifies core services from visual and transcript sources: S3 bucket for file uploads, EventBridge for event routing, Step Functions for workflow orchestration, Lambda for step execution, SageMaker for real-time model inference, and Managed Textract for text extraction.
2. Establishes document flow: Uploaded files in S3 send events through EventBridge, triggering Step Functions.
3. Step Functions coordinates Lambda function execution, invoking SageMaker for custom image analysis and Textract for text extraction.
4. Once post-processing finishes, Step Functions emits completion events back to EventBridge.

graph.name: Docebo AI Powered Document Processing Pipeline
graph.notes: Docebo uses this serverless architecture to process 10-20 documents per day (30-50 pages per minute) and reduce document noise by about 80%. Uploaded PDFs stored in S3 send events through EventBridge to trigger a Step Functions workflow powered by Lambda. The pipeline uses a custom ML model on SageMaker real-time endpoints for image analysis and Managed Textract for text extraction, returning completion notifications to EventBridge.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores uploaded PDF documents containing text and images.

nodes.name: EVENTBRIDGE
nodes.notes: Main event bus that triggers processing workflows and receives completion notifications.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Powers Step Functions steps, converting pages to images and conducting semantic post-processing.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER
nodes.notes: Real-time endpoint hosting custom machine learning model for page image analysis.

nodes.name: MANAGED TEXTRACT
nodes.notes: Managed API used for extracting text from document pages.

edges.notes: Provides document reference payload stored in S3 to processing workflow.
EventBridge triggers Step Functions execution upon document upload event.
Lambda passes converted page images to SageMaker endpoint for visual model analysis.
SageMaker returns ML inference analysis results back to Lambda.
Step Functions invokes Managed Textract for document text extraction.
Textract returns extracted text to Step Functions workflow.
Step Functions sends completion notification events back to EventBridge.
